vocabulary.meaning_en: a meeting where a manager reviews your work and plans the next year
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل: appraise. في أمريكا يقولون غالبًا performance review.
vocabulary.note_en: Verb: appraise. In the US often called a performance review.
vocabulary.example: I have my appraisal with my manager on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to look again at something to judge it
vocabulary.example: Let's review your performance this year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how well you do your work
vocabulary.example: Her performance this year was excellent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: goals you plan to achieve
vocabulary.example: Let's set some objectives for next year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to decide on goals
vocabulary.example: We set three objectives for the team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think about the future
vocabulary.example: Let's look ahead to next year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the good and bad times
vocabulary.example: Every year has its highs and lows.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last of several bad things, after which you must act
vocabulary.example: Stealing the pens was the final straw.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a polite way to say you have dismissed someone
vocabulary.example: The company had to let two people go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to dismiss someone from their job (informal)
vocabulary.example: He was sacked for stealing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to show other people your good qualities
vocabulary.example: An interview is your chance to sell yourself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something nice said about someone
vocabulary.example: She received many compliments for her work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make or become better
vocabulary.example: I want to improve my presentation skills.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that something is true, often something bad
vocabulary.example: Don't be ashamed to admit your mistakes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the amount you are expected to sell
vocabulary.example: We need to reach our sales target this month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to create a new product or idea over time
vocabulary.example: I'd like you to develop a new product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan for selling and advertising products
vocabulary.example: We need a new marketing strategy for Europe.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write a full report from notes
vocabulary.example: Could you write up your appraisal by Friday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a very difficult job to do
vocabulary.example: She has her work cut out this year.

vocabulary.word: put someone out of a job
vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone lose their job
vocabulary.example: Robots might put some people out of a job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to begin
vocabulary.example: If you've time, we could make a start now.

fine_lines.title: compliment vs complement
fine_lines.explanation_ar: compliment (بحرف i) تعني مديحًا أو كلامًا لطيفًا. complement (بحرف e) تعني شيئًا يكمّل شيئًا آخر ويجعله أفضل. وتُنطق الكلمتان بالطريقة نفسها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A compliment (with i) is something nice you say. A complement (with e) is something that completes or goes well with something else.

examples.sentence: Paul gave Anna a compliment on her sales.
The new designer is a good complement to the team.

fine_lines.title: let someone go vs sack
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: إنهاء عمل الموظف. let someone go أسلوب مهذب وغير مباشر، أما sack فهي كلمة غير رسمية ومباشرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean ending someone's job. 'Let someone go' is polite and indirect; 'sack' is informal and direct.

examples.sentence: We've had to let her go.

expressions.phrase: What has gone well for you this year? Give me some examples.
expressions.meaning_ar: ما الأمور التي نجحت فيها هذا العام؟ أعطني بعض الأمثلة.
expressions.meaning_en: A typical appraisal question about successes.
expressions.example: What has gone well for you this year? Give me some examples.

expressions.phrase: And what didn't go so well?
expressions.meaning_ar: وما الأمور التي لم تسِر على ما يرام؟
expressions.example: And what didn't go so well this year?

expressions.phrase: What should you do more of?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما الأشياء التي ينبغي أن تُكثر منها؟
expressions.example: What should you do more of next year?

expressions.phrase: Let's look ahead and set some objectives.
expressions.meaning_ar: لنتطلع إلى المستقبل ونحدد بعض الأهداف.
expressions.meaning_en: Moving on to plans for the next year.
expressions.example: Now let's look ahead and set some objectives.

expressions.phrase: If you've time, we could make a start now.
expressions.meaning_ar: إن كان لديك وقت، يمكننا أن نبدأ الآن.
expressions.example: If you've time, we could make a start now.

expressions.phrase: Could you have it back to me by Friday?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك إعادته إليّ بحلول يوم الجمعة؟
expressions.example: Could you write up the report and have it back to me by Friday?
Don't worry about the client. Leave it with me.

grammar.title: Present perfect vs past simple in reviews
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع التام لفترة لم تنتهِ بعد (this year): What has gone well this year? ونستخدم الماضي البسيط لحدث منتهٍ في وقت محدد: I completed two contracts in March.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present perfect for a time period that is not finished (this year): What has gone well this year? Use the past simple for a finished event: I completed two contracts in March.
examples: What has gone well for you this year?
I completed two big contracts in the spring.

grammar.title: should for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: should + الفعل تُستخدم للنصيحة أو لما هو مستحسن: What should you do more of? You should improve your sales.
grammar.explanation_en: Use should + base verb for advice or what is a good idea: What should you do more of?
examples: What should you do more of?

questions.question: What is an appraisal?
choices: a meeting to review your work and set goals
questions.explanation_en: An appraisal reviews your performance and sets goals.

questions.question: Complete: 'Let's look ahead and ___ some objectives.'
Complete: 'What ___ gone well for you this year?'
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع التام مع what (مفرد): has gone.
questions.explanation_en: Present perfect with a singular subject: has gone.

questions.question: 'Stealing the pens was the final straw.' What does 'the final straw' mean?
choices: the last bad thing that makes you act
questions.explanation_ar: the final straw هو آخر خطأ بعد سلسلة أخطاء يستدعي التحرك.
questions.explanation_en: It's the last bad thing after which you must act.

questions.question: Which is the polite way to say someone was dismissed?
choices: We've had to let her go.
questions.explanation_en: 'Let someone go' is the polite phrase.

questions.question: Paul gave Anna a ___ on her selling.
'Anna has her work cut out' means…
choices: she cut her work into pieces
she has a very difficult job ahead
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير يعني أن أمامها عملًا شاقًا.
questions.explanation_en: It means she has a very hard job to do.

questions.question: Which question is NOT an appraisal question from the episode?
choices: What should you do more of?
Where did you buy your biscuits?
What has gone well for you this year?
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن البسكويت ليس من أسئلة التقييم.
questions.explanation_en: The biscuit question is not an appraisal question.

questions.question: Complete: 'Could you write ___ your appraisal and have it back to me by Friday?'
questions.explanation_ar: write up تعني كتابة التقرير بشكل نهائي.
questions.explanation_en: 'Write up' means write a full report.

questions.question: What does 'sell yourself' mean in an appraisal?
choices: show your good qualities and successes
questions.explanation_ar: sell yourself تعني إبراز نقاط قوتك.
